page.layout: One printed title page, centred; below it a handwritten inscription and library stamps (not transcribed).
page.notes: Handwritten ownership inscription in ink below the title, and an oval library stamp (BIBLIOTECA NAZIONALE, ROMA) in green; a circular emblem stamp at lower right. None of these are printed text and they are not transcribed. Title lines are set in roman capitals, with DE in italic; the lower line is in small capitals.
